verdict.rationale: Unity documents Services Web APIs with OpenAPI specs, isolated environments, and an MCP server and CLI for agents, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as service accounts with roles, permission-limited keys or per-agent tokens. Environments are logical data partitions, not credential scoping, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
